qf.m_usIDSpace.h: ID group the ID belongs to (newer versions). Usually 0.
qf.m_ID.h: Unique quest number. Also the key that encodes the name and texts.
qf.m_bHasSign.h: On: the quest stores a signature text (30 characters) at the end of the block.
qf.m_pszSignature.h: Signature text stored in the quest.
qf.m_ulType.h: Category shown in the quest log (main, daily, event etc.).
qf.m_ulTimeLimit.h: Seconds to finish after accepting. 0 = no limit.
qf.m_ulSuitableLevel.h: Recommended level shown to the player; does not block.
qf.m_bKeyTask.h: Marks it as a main story quest.
qf.m_bShowPrompt.h: Shows the "quest available" notice to the player.
qf.m_bHidden.h: Does not appear in the quest log.
qf.m_bCanSeekOut.h: Appears in the quest search ("available quests" list).
qf.m_bShowDirection.h: Shows the arrow/direction to the goal.
qf.m_bSkillTask.h: Quest tied to learning a skill.
qf.m_bIsLibraryTask.h: Drawn from a quest library (with the chance below).
qf.m_fLibraryTasksProbability.h: Chance of being drawn from the library (0 to 1).
qf.m_iMaskDisableIcon.h: Mask of icons turned off in the interface.
qf.m_bWriteSpecialLog.h: The server logs the quest separately.
qf.m_bOfflineFail.h: On: the quest fails if the player disconnects.
qf.m_bAbsFail.h: On: fails at the "Fail date" date/time.
qf.m_bAbsTime.h: On: can only be accepted at the times in the list below.
qf.m_ulTimetable.h: How many times are in the list.
qf.m_tmType.h: How the time repeats (day, week, month…).
qf.m_lAvailFrequency.h: Repetition: 0 = unlimited, 1 = per day, 2 = per week, 3 = per month…
qf.m_lFrequencyNum.h: How many times it can be done in each frequency period.
qf.m_bChooseOne.h: The player picks one of the subquests.
qf.m_bRandOne.h: The game draws one of the subquests.
qf.m_bExeChildInOrder.h: Subquests are done one after another.
qf.m_bParentAlsoFail.h: If this one fails, the parent quest fails too.
qf.m_bParentAlsoSucc.h: If this one completes, the parent quest completes too.
qf.m_bCanRedo.h: Can be done again after completion.
qf.m_bClearAsGiveUp.h: On give up, erases the record (can accept again).
qf.m_ulMaxReceiver.h: How many players on the server can have the quest at once. 0 = no limit.
qf.m_ulDelvNPC.h: NPC where the player accepts the quest.
qf.m_ulAwardNPC.h: NPC where the player hands in the quest and gets the reward. 0 = completes by itself.
qf.m_bAutoDeliver.h: The quest is given without talking to an NPC (when requirements are met).
qf.m_bDelvInZone.h: The quest is given on entering the delivery regions.
qf.m_ulDelvWorld.h: Map ID of the delivery regions.
qf.m_bClearAcquired.h: On completion, removes the quest items obtained.
qf.m_iDeliveredSkillID.h: ID of the skill given on accept.
qf.m_bCompareItemAndInventory.h: Only accepts if it fits in the inventory.
qf.m_bTransTo.h: On accept, takes the player to the point below.
qf.m_lMonsCtrl.h: Controller ID (npcgen) turned on or off.
qf.m_bTrigCtrl.h: On: activates the controller; off: deactivates it.
qf.m_bPQTask.h: Public quest (PQ): counts everyone's contribution in the event.
qf.m_ulChangeKeyCnt.h: Keys = variables stored on the server that the quest changes.
qf.m_nPropExp1AndOrExp2.h: 0 = AND, 1 = OR between the two comparisons.
qf.nLeftType.h: 0 = fixed value, 1 = global key, 2 = personal key…
qf.m_fVaguePromptRadius.h: The arrow only shows an approximate area of this radius.
qf.m_bShowByLev.h: On: the quest only appears in the list when the level is met.
qf.m_ulPremItems.h: Items the player must have to accept.
qf.m_ulGivenItems.h: Items handed to the player on accept.
qf.m_ulPremise_Task_Count.h: Quests that must be completed first.
qf.m_ulPremise_Task_Least_Num.h: How many of the previous quests are enough. 0 = all.
qf.m_ulPremise_Cotask.h: Quest that must be active/completed alongside.
qf.m_ulMutexTaskCount.h: Quests that cannot be active at the same time.
qf.m_bRcvByTeam.h: On accept, the whole party receives the quest.
qf.m_enumMethod.h: 0 = none, 1 = kill monsters, 2 = collect items, 3 = talk to NPC, 4 = reach place, 5 = wait time…
qf.m_enumFinishType.h: 0 = by talking to the receiving NPC, 1 = by itself when done.
qf.m_ulDropItemId.h: Quest item the monster drops during the quest.
qf.m_bDropCmnItem.h: On: the dropped item is common (not a quest item).
qf.m_bCommonItem.h: On: common item; off: quest item.
qf.m_uiEmotion.h: Emote action the player must perform.
qf.m_ulSubmitItemWantedNum: No. of items to hand in
qf.m_bUseLevCo.h: The reward is multiplied by a factor of the player's level.
qf.m_bRandChoose.h: On: the player gets only one item drawn from the group.
qs.m_AwByRatio_S.h: Varies with the fraction of time used.
qs.m_AwByItems_S.h: Varies with the amount of items handed in.
